news.title: 11 arrested, drugs seized in Clayton County sweep, deputies say
news.summary: Clayton County deputies arrested 11 people and confiscated an illegally modified handgun alongside illicit drugs during street patrols over the past week, according to the sheriff's office.

news.title: Felon admits to firing shots, burying gun in southwest Atlanta: police
news.summary: A felon was arrested early Monday morning after admitting to firing shots in a southwest Atlanta parking lot and burying a handgun in nearby woods, according to the police.

news.title: 2 arrested in Illinois for deadly northwest Atlanta shooting, police say
news.summary: Two suspects, including a 15-year-old, were arrested in Illinois this week in connection with a deadly summer shooting of a 33-year-old man in northwest Atlanta, police announced.

news.title: Police investigating two separate shootings in South Atlanta
news.summary: Police have detained a possible suspect. Aggravated assault investigators also responded to determine the circumstances around the shooting.

news.title: 2 shot in Atlanta, possible suspect detained
news.summary: Atlanta police say they are investigating a shooting in southeast Atlanta Saturday afternoon. A possible suspect was detained.

news.title: Possible suspect detained after 2 injured in Atlanta shooting: APD
news.summary: A possible suspect has been detained after gunfire left a man and a woman injured in Atlanta on Saturday afternoon, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Man killed, woman injured after shooting in southwest Atlanta, APD says
news.summary: A 28-year-old man died, and a 20-year-old woman was hurt after gunfire erupted in the Pittsburgh neighborhood late Friday night, according to police.

news.title: Rabies alert: Dead raccoon tests positive in DeKalb County
news.summary: A dead raccoon tested positive for rabies on Friday in the Meadow Rock area.

news.title: 2 teens charged months after Atlanta man’s killing
news.summary: Two suspects have been arrested in Illinois in connection with a deadly shooting in northwest Atlanta in June, police said.

news.title: Man killed, woman injured in Atlanta shooting
news.summary: One person is dead and another injured in a shooting in southwest Atlanta, police said.

news.title: ‘Not all heroes wear capes:’ Barrow deputy rescues chickens from burning coop
news.summary: A metro Atlanta deputy rushed into a burning chicken coop to rescue nearly a dozen chickens trapped inside, according to the sheriff’s office.

news.title: 1 dead, 2 hurt in Atlanta shooting
news.summary: Officers discovered a trail of blood at the scene, APD said.

news.title: Gunfire on Sylvan Road SW leaves 1 dead and 2 hospitalized in Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating a fatal shooting on Sylvan Road SW that left one man dead Friday night.
